cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a small present-day optical-illusion theatre with burgundy curtains and a brightly lit empty demonstration stage — enjoying a stage-magic rehearsal; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sunny present-day seaside gelato terrace with curved ceramic benches and blurred blue fishing boats far below — testing how far a stretchy scoop of ice cream will stretch from its cup; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — pours tea from a small teapot into a cup on the table; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; an underground subway platform — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — standing
